flowchart BT

  style orders fill:#ffffff,stroke:#b0b0b0
  checkout -.-> catalog
  checkout <--> catalog
  fulfillment --- browsing
  checkout --- search
  linkStyle 0 interpolate step stroke:#313131,stroke-width:1.5px,stroke-dasharray:3 3

diagram/roles-collapsed-merge-no-child-l.source:
---
{"config":{"theme":"base","layout":"elk","look":"handDrawn","flowchart":{"curve":"step","htmlLabels":true},"themeVariables":{"fontFamily":"system-ui, sans-serif","fontSize":"14px","lineColor":"#313131"},"elk":{"mergeEdges":false,"nodePlacementStrategy":"BRANDES_KOEPF"}}}
---
flowchart BT
  classDef core fill:#dedaff,stroke:#6631d7,color:#1a1a1a
  classDef supporting fill:#c6dcff,stroke:#305bab,color:#1a1a1a
  classDef generic fill:#adf0c7,stroke:#067429,color:#1a1a1a
  classDef focus stroke-width:4px,font-weight:bold
  subgraph catalog["Catalog"]
    browsing["Browsing"]:::core
    search["Search"]:::core
  end
  style catalog fill:#f7f7ff,stroke:#6631d7,color:#1a1a1a
  orders["Orders"]:::core
  crm["CRM"]:::supporting
  subgraph foundations["Shared Foundations"]
    identity["Identity"]:::generic
    payments["Payments"]:::generic
  end
  style foundations fill:#eaf9ef,stroke:#067429,stroke-dasharray:4 3,color:#1a1a1a
  orders --> identity
  crm --> identity
  orders --> payments
  orders -.-> catalog
  crm --> orders
  orders <--> catalog
  orders --- browsing
  orders --- search
  payments --- crm
  linkStyle 0,1,4 interpolate step stroke:#313131,stroke-width:1.5px
  linkStyle 2 interpolate step stroke:#313131,stroke-width:1.5px
  linkStyle 3 interpolate step stroke:#313131,stroke-width:1.5px,stroke-dasharray:3 3
  linkStyle 5 interpolate step stroke:#d32f2f,stroke-width:2px
  linkStyle 6,7 interpolate step stroke:#313131,stroke-width:1.5px
  linkStyle 8 interpolate step stroke:#313131,stroke-width:1.5px
  %% violations: 5
  %% roles: 0=OHS,PL>ACL;4=>CF
  %% kernels: 2,8
  click browsing href "#focus=browsing&display.foundations=expanded&display.orders=collapsed"
  click search href "#focus=search&display.foundations=expanded&display.orders=collapsed"
  click orders href "#focus=orders&display.foundations=expanded&display.orders=collapsed"
  click crm href "#focus=crm&display.foundations=expanded&display.orders=collapsed"
  click identity href "#focus=identity&display.foundations=expanded&display.orders=collapsed"
  click payments href "#focus=payments&display.foundations=expanded&display.orders=collapsed"
